item.title: Ações europeias têm perda semanal com turbulência na França e petróleo abalando otimismo com balanços
item.description: As ações europeias sofreram sua maior queda semanal desde o início de setembro à medida que as tensões na França e os preços mais altos do petróleo abalaram o otimismo gerado por alguns balanços corporativos fortes.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: As ações europeias sofreram sua maior queda semanal desde o início de setembro à medida que as tensões na França e os preços mais altos do petróleo abalaram o otimismo gerado por alguns balanços corporativos fortes. O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) caiu 0,31%, fechando em 635,77 pontos nesta sexta-feira. Na semana, o índice de referência registrou queda de cerca de 1,4%. A semana foi repleta de divulgações de resultados de grandes empresas como SAP (SAPG.DE) , Barclays (BARC.L) e Kering (PRTP.PA) , que ofereceram novas perspectivas sobre as condições econômicas e a confiança do consumidor. As estimativas gerais de lucros melhoraram para as empresas europeias, mas os preços mais altos do petróleo bruto e a agitação na França deixaram investidores nervosos. “O que está acontecendo na França vai, no mínimo, persistir como um fator de mercado durante todo o ciclo eleitoral. Os protestos podem se dissipar, mas isso não muda a realidade financeira que a França está enfrentando”, disse Josh Stevens, diretor de investimentos da CresAlta Investment Management. A turbulência criou um cenário explosivo para a eleição presidencial no país, marcada para abril do ano que vem. Empresas e museus planejaram fechar durante o fim de semana, apesar das restrições às manifestações, enquanto o presidente francês Emmanuel Macron busca restaurar a ordem uma semana após protestos em todo o país terem se tornado violentos. Os investidores vão analisar minuciosamente a decisão da Moody’s sobre a recomendação de crédito da França, prevista para o final do dia. FRAQUEZA DO SETOR DE LUXO ABALA HUMOR DO MERCADO A Kering (PRTP.PA) caiu 16,6% nesta sexta-feira após reportar queda nas vendas do terceiro trimestre de sua marca principal, a Gucci. A ação foi a que mais ficou para trás no STOXX 600, e o índice de luxo (.STXLUXP) — o setor europeu com pior desempenho até agora neste ano — caiu 3,6%. “O setor de luxo europeu continua sofrendo com a guerra no Oriente Médio e com a redução do apetite de consumo da China”, disse Ipek Ozkardeskaya, analista sênior da Swissquote. A L’Oréal (OREP.PA) subiu 5,6% depois que o grupo francês de cosméticos superou as previsões de vendas do terceiro trimestre. As ações do setor de defesa (.SXPARO) caíram 3,8%, registrando seu pior dia desde 1º de junho, arrastadas por uma queda de 10% na fabricante francesa de motores a jato Safran (SAF.PA) após a divulgação de seus resultados. O Banco Central Europeu deve se reunir na próxima semana, com os investidores precificando uma probabilidade de mais de 91% de que ele mantenha as taxas de juros inalteradas. O BCE elevou as taxas de juros duas vezes este ano para conter as pressões inflacionárias decorrentes dos preços elevados do petróleo. O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou em queda de 0,31%, a 635,77 pontos. Em LONDRES, o índice Financial Times (.FTSE) recuou 0,32%, a 10.690,36 pontos. Em FRANKFURT, o índice DAX (.GDAXI) caiu 0,75%, a 25.181,65 pontos. Em PARIS, o índice CAC-40 (.FCHI) perdeu 0,36%, a 7.782,82 pontos. Em MILÃO, o índice Ftse/Mib (.FTMIB) teve valorização de 0,36%, a 48.558,86 pontos. Em MADRI, o índice Ibex-35 (.IBEX) registrou alta de 0,40%, a 18.989,80 pontos. Em LISBOA, o índice PSI20 (.PSI20) valorizou-se 0,07%, a 9.244,62 pontos.

item.title: CVC, GBL hold 74.3% of Italian drugmaker Recordati at end of takeover offer period
item.description: CVC and Belgian investment firm GBL , which this month raised their bid for Italian pharmaceutical group Recordati to €53 a share, had secured a 74.3% stake in the firm by the end of the offer period, a regulatory filing showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CVC (CVC.AS) and Belgian investment firm GBL (GBLB.BR) , which this month [USN:L8N45S0A3 TEXT:"raised their bid"] for Italian pharmaceutical group Recordati (RECI.MI) to €53 a share, had secured a 74.3% stake in the firm by the end of the offer period, a regulatory filing showed on Friday. That put the consortium above the 66.7% minimum acceptance threshold they had set for the offer — which values Recordati at around €11 billion — but short of the 90% level required to delist the drugmaker The Italian Stock Exchange said on Friday investors had tendered Recordati shares to the bidding consortium for a 62.15% stake That adds to a further 6.9% stake acquired by CVC on the market, GBL's 3.3% holding and an additional 1.96% stake obtained by CVC through the exercise of derivatives The bidders will reopen the offer between November 3 and 9 Their vehicle has said that, should the 90% threshold not be reached, it could pursue a merger with Recordati, leaving minority shareholders with stock in an unlisted company Recordati owns treasury shares for around 0.5% of its capital, according to a financial source

item.title: Verstappen says Austin circuit's bumpy ride gets his back up
item.description: Max Verstappen fears the bumpy ride at Austin's Circuit of the Americas is out of control and could do long-term damage to his spine.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Max Verstappen fears the bumpy ride at Austin's Circuit of the Americas is out of control and could do long-term damage to his spine. Red Bull's four-time world champion joked to reporters after he won the Singapore Grand Prix, the race before Austin, that he would "probably need to order a new spine" for the race at the Circuit of the Americas and "become like Robocop". The Dutch driver returned to the theme on arrival in Texas by emphasising it was a serious concern. "I was joking about that, of course, in the last race. But it's not really a joke to be honest, because we mentioned this already for years that it's actually getting a bit out of control," he said. The 29-year-old said that last year, in a race he won, he had pulled 5-6 G-force in some corners and put more than 9G on his spine in vertical load. "Especially the older you get, you think about that more and more," he said. "That's not what you want. And with these cars, especially under braking, you bottom out way harder... and I know around here, in some places, it's very bumpy under braking." "From the checks that I've done from my spine, the bottom end doesn't look that great... I know that can be part of sport but it's also further damage from the cars that we had the last few years. And now if we continue with driving or finding this acceptable to drive on then you are going to suffer with that much more." Verstappen said he loved the layout, which he described as one of the best, and being in the nearby city but the bumps were unacceptable and needed fixing but that would require costly excavating works. His comments drew some support from other drivers, including McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris who said he had also suffered. "It's pretty bad. There's a lot of places I need to take headache tablets before I go out, simply because it's so bumpy and you're hitting your head pretty hard against the headrests and things because of the bumps. So it's certainly not a nice thing. But there's not much we can do," said the Briton. Mercedes' George Russell said rule changes had made the problem worse. "We're not an IndyCar or an F2 car that run their ride heights reasonably high; our ride heights are 10 mil (millimetres) at the end of the straight, a centimetre from the ground. So, any tiny bump, you really feel it and the side profile of the tyres now, since we've been with the 18-inch, is substantially smaller. "The circumference of the tyre is the same, the circumference of the rim is far greater. So, you've lost all of that effective suspension in the tyre, which was a damper that we kind of don't have anymore."

item.title: Report: Bears TE Cole Kmet (knee) likely out for season
item.description: Chicago Bears tight end Cole Kmet is likely to miss the rest of the season with a knee injury sustained in Thursday night's win over the New England Patriots, NFL Network reported Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chicago Bears tight end Cole Kmet is likely to miss the rest of the season with a knee injury sustained in Thursday night's win over the New England Patriots, NFL Network reported Friday. Kmet was carted off the field in the fourth quarter. He grabbed his right knee after being tackled low following an 8-yard catch, finishing the 30-24 home victory with three receptions for 28 yards. Head coach Ben Johnson told reporters after the game the injury did not look good. Kmet was scheduled for further testing on Friday to confirm a diagnosis. Kmet, 27, has 10 receptions for 87 yards and one touchdown in seven games (three starts) this season. He has one season left on a four-year, $50 million contract extension signed in July 2023. Drafted by Chicago in the second round out of Notre Dame in 2020, Kmet has collected 298 catches for 3,026 yards and 22 TDs in 107 career games (94 starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: Wall Street ve una oportunidad de inversión en General Motors tras caer 8% esta semana
item.description: Las acciones de General Motors acumulan una caída semanal del 8% y se encaminan a su mayor retroceso desde enero de 2025, luego de que la automotriz ajustara sus previsiones de ganancias para 2026.
item.dc:creator: Jordan Fitzgerald, Paul Roman, Jordan Fitzgerald
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Las acciones de General Motors Co. ( GM ) apuntan a registrar su peor semana en más de 20 meses, sin embargo, los analistas optimistas de Wall Street siguen apostando fuerte por ellas. Hasta el cierre de este jueves, las acciones del fabricante de automóviles han bajado un 8%, lo que las sitúa en camino de registrar su mayor caída semanal desde enero de 2025, y los analistas afirman que los inversionistas deberían aprovechar el baja para comprar. Ver más: General Motors volverá a ofrecer CarPlay de Apple en sus nuevas camionetas Chevrolet y GMC Este martes, la empresa redujo los límites superior e inferior del rango de previsiones de beneficios para este año, y su CEO, Mary Barra, advirtió de que GM se enfrenta a “claros obstáculos externos”, lo que provocó una caída del 6,8% en la cotización, en la peor jornada bursátil desde julio de 2025. “La barra estaba alta”, señaló Mickey Legg, analista de StoneX. “Se trata de una oportunidad de compra. Lo que más ha inquietado al mercado es el momento elegido, más que la capacidad de generar beneficios”. Legg, de StoneX, que mantiene una recomendación de “comprar” para GM, no es el único en defender esta postura. Ninguno de los analistas a los que sigue Bloomberg recomienda vender las acciones después de que Wells Fargo dejara de cubrir a la empresa tras la salida de uno de sus analistas el mes pasado. Aun así, las acciones de GM han bajado en lo que va de 2026, cayendo mientras el S&P 500 subía. Los analistas de BNP Paribas, Evercore ISI y RBC Capital Markets se han hecho eco de la recomendación de comprar en las caídas tras los resultados de este martes. James Picariello, de BNP, reiteró su recomendación equivalente a “comprar”, citando la “valoración muy rebajada” de GM y su ejecución sin parangón. Cuando GM presentó sus últimos resultados en julio, los beneficios trimestrales superaron las expectativas y la dirección revisó al alza sus previsiones. Las acciones se recuperaron en los días siguientes hasta alcanzar un máximo histórico. No obstante, desde entonces, la acción ha caído como consecuencia de los elevados precios del petróleo y los altos costes, las elevadas tasas de interés y la débil confianza de los consumidores. “El mercado se centró excesivamente en estos obstáculos a corto plazo, sin tener en cuenta la mejora del rendimiento operativo, los márgenes y la generación de efectivo de la compañía”, explicó Ivan Feinseth, director de inversiones de Tigress Financial Partners. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: GRANOS La soja sube en Chicago gracias a la demanda de exportación y al sector energético
item.description: La soja de Chicago subía por segunda sesión consecutiva el viernes, ya que las dinámicas exportaciones estadounidenses, impulsadas por la renovada demanda china, ayudaron a contrarrestar la presión sobre los precios derivada de una cosecha récord prevista en el Medio Oeste de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La soja de Chicago subía por segunda sesión consecutiva el viernes, ya que las dinámicas exportaciones estadounidenses, impulsadas por la renovada demanda china, ayudaron a contrarrestar la presión sobre los precios derivada de una cosecha récord prevista en el Medio Oeste de Estados Unidos. * El maíz bajaba ante el avance de la cosecha, mientras que el trigo subía ligeramente, ya que continuaron los ataques que interrumpen el tráfico marítimo en el mar Negro en el marco de la guerra de Rusia contra Ucrania. * El contrato de soja más negociado en la Bolsa de Chicago (CBOT, por su sigla en inglés) sumaba 4,25 centavos, a 12,5725 dólares el bushel a las 1602 GMT. * "La soja se está viendo respaldada por unas cifras de demanda sólidas y por la idea de que Brasil podría ser menos competitivo en el mercado mundial este año", afirmó Karl Setzer, cofundador de Consus Ag Consulting. "La fortaleza del sector energético también está respaldando a la soja", añadió. * El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos informó el jueves que las ventas netas de exportación de soja estadounidense en la semana que finalizó el 15 de octubre ascendieron a 2,8 millones de toneladas métricas, cerca del límite superior de las estimaciones del mercado, ya que una racha de compras chinas impulsó los volúmenes. * Además, el viernes subían los precios del petróleo, y el crudo Brent alcanzó su máximo desde principios de mayo, después de que los ataques hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron la preocupación por nuevas interrupciones en el suministro energético procedente de Oriente Medio, donde las autoridades de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos también informaron de un vertido de petróleo. * El maíz de la CBOT bajaba 4,25 centavos a 4,5625 dólares el bushel, mientras que el trigo de la CBOT subía 3,75 centavos a 6,2850 dólares el bushel. * El maíz se ha visto afectado por el avance de la cosecha estadounidense, lo que podría reforzar aún más las ya abultadas existencias del país. * El mercado del trigo registró esta semana operaciones de liquidación por parte de los fondos de inversión, ya que una ronda de negociaciones diplomáticas lideradas por Estados Unidos y destinadas a poner fin a la guerra de Rusia contra Ucrania ha suscitado esperanzas de una reactivación del comercio de cereales del mar Negro. * Sin embargo, los ataques han continuado desde las negociaciones, incluido un ataque con drones que hundió un buque de carga frente a la costa rumana del mar Negro.

item.title: Shein concorda em pagar US$100 mi para encerrar investigação de órgão de comércio dos EUA
item.description: A gigante chinesa de fast fashion Shein concordou em pagar US$100 milhões para encerrar uma investigação da Comissão Federal de Comércio dos Estados Unidos (FTC) sobre atrasos na entrega e outras reclamações de clientes, disse uma fonte com conhecimento direto do assunto à Reuters na sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A gigante chinesa de fast fashion Shein (0625.HK) concordou em pagar US$100 milhões para encerrar uma investigação da Comissão Federal de Comércio dos Estados Unidos (FTC) sobre atrasos na entrega e outras reclamações de clientes, disse uma fonte com conhecimento direto do assunto à Reuters na sexta-feira. O acordo, equivalente a 44% do lucro do segundo trimestre da Shein, é o mais recente a atingir a varejista online de moda rápida, que enfrenta uma repressão regulatória e tributária na Europa e nos EUA, o que freou seu crescimento. A Shein, fundada na China, mas com sede em Cingapura, afirmou em comunicado à Reuters que "chegou a um acordo construtivo com a FTC" e que mais informações serão divulgadas em breve. Um porta-voz da FTC se recusou a comentar. A empresa já havia alertado, em documentos apresentados em julho para seu IPO em Hong Kong, que a investigação dos EUA poderia resultar em multas significativas. Segundo registros da FTC analisados pela Reuters, os consumidores registraram mais de 12.000 reclamações contra a Shein, referentes a compras que totalizaram mais de US$11 milhões entre janeiro de 2020 e junho de 2026. Pelo menos alguns desses problemas estão relacionados ao envio, com clientes relatando à FTC e ao Better Business Bureau que nunca receberam pacotes que a Shein havia marcado como entregues e que o serviço de atendimento ao cliente da Shein não resolveu o problema. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar de forma independente o conteúdo das queixas, nem se elas foram resolvidas. Além de vender roupas de marca própria, o site da Shein também funciona como um mercado online onde vendedores terceirizados oferecem de tudo, desde brinquedos a eletrodomésticos e itens de decoração. DIFICULDADES PARA A SHEIN As ações da Shein já caíram 22% desde sua estreia na bolsa em 1º de setembro, à medida que os investidores perceberam o impacto negativo que as taxas de 3 euros da União Europeia sobre pacotes de comércio eletrônico de baixo valor tiveram em seus negócios na região. E a Shein enfrentará mais dificuldades, já que a UE imporá uma taxa adicional de processamento de 2 euros a partir de 1º de novembro, elevando a taxa total para 5 euros por código aduaneiro individual. "A forma como essas tarifas são implementadas é especialmente prejudicial para a Shein", disse Mike Ryan, chefe de insights de comércio eletrônico da Smarter Ecommerce, que acompanhou como a Shein reduziu seus gastos com visibilidade no Google Ads na Europa. A Shein era conhecida por vender vestidos de US$5 e calças jeans de US$10, mas foi obrigada a aumentar seus preços depois que os EUA e, posteriormente, a Europa fecharam as brechas nas leis alfandegárias. A presidente-executiva Sky Xu afirmou no mês passado que a Shein desenvolveria mais marcas com preços mais elevados, numa tentativa de aumentar a rentabilidade. A Shein também continua sob investigação da Comissão Europeia devido a produtos ilegais em seu marketplace. No ano passado, a empresa foi multada em 150 milhões de euros pela autoridade francesa de proteção de dados pelo uso indevido de cookies. Não é a primeira vez que a FTC toma medidas contra varejistas online por causa de entregas. A empresa norte-americana Fashion Nova foi multada em US$9,3 milhões em 2020 por não cumprir as promessas de entrega aos clientes e por oferecer cartões-presente em vez de reembolsos. A Hey Dude, empresa pertencente à Crocs Inc., também foi multada em US$1,95 milhão em 2023 por não notificar os clientes sobre atrasos na entrega e por suprimir avaliações negativas. (Por Helen Reid e Jody Godoy)

item.title: スターリンク利用に問題なら解決へ、トランプ氏が表明
item.description: [ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、ウクライナで衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の利用に依然として問題があるなら、自ら解決すると述べた。

ホワイトハウスで記者団に対し、この問題についてスペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）とは話していないが、利用上の問題が解消されなければ同氏と話すとし、「問題があるなら、私が解決する」と明言した。

ウクライナ当局者は２３日、国内でスターリンクの速度制限が続いていると述べた。サービスが完全に復旧したとするトランプ氏の先の発言と食い違っている。

トランプ氏は「イーロンは決して間違ったことはしない。私は彼をよく知っている。彼は公正な人物だ。ウクライナが民間企業と話し合っているというのは異例の状況だが、彼が間違ったことをすることはない」と語った。

item.title: Entrenador del Bayern, Kompany, es trasladado al hospital tras desmayarse durante un entrenamiento
item.description: El entrenador del Bayern de Múnich, Vincent Kompany, fue trasladado de urgencia al hospital el viernes tras desmayarse durante una sesión de entrenamiento, informó el club bávaro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El entrenador del Bayern de Múnich, Vincent Kompany, fue trasladado de urgencia al hospital el viernes tras desmayarse durante una sesión de entrenamiento, informó el club bávaro. El técnico belga llevaba varios días con un virus y se había perdido algunos entrenamientos de su equipo. "El viernes, Vincent Kompany necesitó atención médica tras desmayarse durante una sesión de entrenamiento del equipo filial del Bayern", declaró el club bávaro. "El entrenador del primer equipo había estado observando la sesión del segundo equipo". "Kompany está siendo sometido actualmente a un examen médico exhaustivo en el hospital y permanecerá bajo supervisión médica. Por el momento, su cuerpo técnico se encargará de todas las actividades relacionadas con los entrenamientos y los partidos", agregó. El líder de la Bundesliga, que empató 2-2 en casa contra el Arsenal en la Liga de Campeones esta semana, tiene previsto viajar a Friburgo el domingo. "La salud de Vincent Kompany es nuestra máxima prioridad", declaró Max Eberl, director deportivo de la escuadra muniquesa. "En el Bayern haremos todo lo posible para garantizar que se recupere con rapidez". "Vinnie está recibiendo toda la atención médica y el apoyo necesarios, y se le concederá todo el tiempo que necesite. Toda la familia del FC Bayern le desea a Vinnie una rápida recuperación", agregó.

item.title: 中国、宇宙での軍拡競争に反対 探査の権利保障訴え＝文書
item.description: [北京 ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国外務省は２３日、宇宙での軍拡競争に反対すると表明した。宇宙の探査や平和目的での利用を呼びかけ、すべての国による宇宙の探査や利用の権利が保障されるべきだと訴えている。

外務省が公表した宇宙を巡る中国政府の立場を記した文書によると、宇宙の「武器化」や軍事化のほか、「他国の主権や安全保障、開発上の利益を損なう活動」に利用することに反対し、「宇宙での軍拡競争リスクや戦場化しようとする動きが、宇宙の安全に対する最大の脅威と課題になっている」と言及した。中国は「宇宙の軍拡競争を防ぐためにあらゆる努力を払う」ことを求めていると説明している。

中国は商業的な宇宙活動の規制を求め、宇宙関連の経済の発展を奨励すると主張。商業的な宇宙活動は「他国の正当な権利や利益を侵害してはならず、武力紛争や内政に違法に介入することは避けるべきだ」とした。

item.title: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield (thumb) to start vs. Panthers
item.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is expected to start Sunday's road game against the Carolina Panthers, head coach Todd Bowles said Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is expected to start Sunday's road game against the Carolina Panthers, head coach Todd Bowles said Friday. "(He) looks like he's ready to go," Bowles said of Mayfield, who has missed the last three games with a dislocated thumb. Mayfield sustained his injury during a 23-16 loss to the Minnesota Vikings on Sept. 27. He has thrown for 615 yards with two touchdowns and two interceptions in three games this season. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels has started the last three games for the Buccaneers (1-5). Including his Week 3 appearance off the bench, Daniels has completed 61.2% of his passes for 501 yards, three touchdowns and five interceptions. Mayfield, 31, was officially listed as questionable for Sunday on Friday's injury report despite his third straight day as a full practice participant. Mayfield, who will wear a glove on his right (throwing) hand, will not have wide receiver Emeka Egbuka on the field Sunday. Egbuka (concussion, foot) was ruled out on Friday along with right tackle Luke Goedeke (calf) and safety Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib). --Field Level Media

item.title: Chase Elliott honors Kyle Busch, opts out of 'Most Popular' vote
item.description: Chase Elliott ended his streak of eight consecutive NASCAR Cup Series Most Popular Driver awards to honor the late Kyle Busch.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chase Elliott ended his streak of eight consecutive NASCAR Cup Series Most Popular Driver awards to honor the late Kyle Busch. The National Motorsports Press Association confirmed on Friday that Elliott opted to remove his name from the 2026 ballot. Shortly after Busch's unexpected death in May at the age of 41, Elliott said he was considering the move out of respect for his fellow driver. "I think he's a guy that has had a lot of fans throughout the course of his career," Elliott said then, per The Athletic. "I know the boos and it was fun, and all those things, but (he) had a lot of supporters, a lot of really passionate fans. I just feel like he deserves to win the award, truthfully." Elliott, 30, started his streak of Most Popular Driver awards in 2018. His father, Bill Elliott, set the NASCAR Cup series record by winning the award 16 times, while Dale Earnhardt Jr. owns the longest streak with 15 consecutive wins from 2003-17. Busch is on the ballot and eligible to win. The fan voting opened on Friday morning and runs through Nov. 9. The winner will be announced at NASCAR's season-ending awards banquet on Nov. 10. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump dice que habló con primer ministro británico y trataron el asunto del petróleo
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmó que, durante una conversación mantenida el viernes con el primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham, se centró sobre todo en la explotación petrolera en el mar del Norte y que solo abordó "muy de pasada" los conflictos de Irán y Ucrania.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmó que, durante una conversación mantenida el viernes con el primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham, se centró sobre todo en la explotación petrolera en el mar del Norte y que solo abordó "muy de pasada" los conflictos de Irán y Ucrania. "Están explotando el petróleo del mar del Norte", comentó a la prensa en la Casa Blanca antes de partir hacia Florida para una gira de campaña de cara a las elecciones de mitad de mandato del 3 de noviembre. "Llevo dos años insistiendo en que lo hagan (…) Andy lo está consiguiendo". El miércoles, Trump elogió la exploración petrolera británica en el mar del Norte después de que Londres puso fin a años de disputas legales y políticas para aprobar el yacimiento de gas de Jackdaw, aunque las autoridades dijeron que aún no se ha tomado una decisión sobre el yacimiento petrolífero de Rosebank, más grande.

item.title: Acciones europeas caen en la semana, agitación en Francia y petróleo merman optimismo por resultados
item.description: Las bolsas europeas sufrieron su mayor caída semanal desde principios de septiembre, ya que las tensiones en Francia y el aumento de los precios del petróleo socavaron el optimismo generado por unos sólidos resultados empresariales.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas sufrieron su mayor caída semanal desde principios de septiembre, ya que las tensiones en Francia y el aumento de los precios del petróleo socavaron el optimismo generado por unos sólidos resultados empresariales. * El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) cayó el viernes un 0,31% a 635,77 puntos. En la semana, el índice de referencia bajó alrededor de un 1,4%. * Estos descensos ponen fin a una semana repleta de resultados de gigantes como SAP (SAPG.DE) , Barclays (BARC.L) y Kering (PRTP.PA) , que han aportado nuevos datos sobre la situación económica y la confianza de los consumidores. * En general, las previsiones de beneficios de las empresas europeas han mejorado, pero el aumento de los precios del crudo y los disturbios en Francia han provocado nerviosismo entre los inversores. * Los inversores analizarán con lupa la decisión de Moody’s sobre la calificación crediticia de Francia, que se dará a conocer durante el día. * El viernes, Kering (PRTP.PA) cayó un 16,6% tras el descenso de las ventas del tercer trimestre de su marca insignia, Gucci. La acción fue la que más se rezagó en el STOXX 600, y el índice del sector del lujo (.STXLUXP) -el sector europeo con peor rendimiento en lo que va de año- cayó un 3,6%. * L'Oréal (OREP.PA) subió un 5,6% después de que el grupo francés de cosméticos superó las previsiones de ventas del tercer trimestre. * Las acciones del sector de la defensa (.SXPARO) cayeron un 3,8%, registrando su peor jornada desde el 1 de junio, arrastradas por un desplome del 10% del fabricante francés de motores a reacción Safran (SAF.PA) tras la publicación de sus resultados. * El Banco Central Europeo tiene prevista una reunión la próxima semana, y los inversores descuentan una probabilidad superior al 91% de que mantenga las tasas de interés sin cambios. * El BCE ha subido las tasas de interés en dos ocasiones este año para frenar las presiones inflacionarias derivadas del elevado precio del petróleo. * Volvo Cars (VOLCARb.ST) se hundió más de un 24%, a un mínimo histórico, tras anunciar unas pérdidas operativas en el tercer trimestre superiores a lo previsto y revelar sus planes de recortar otros 2.500 puestos de trabajo.

item.title: US energy department designates helium as critical material
item.description: The US Department of Energy said on Friday that Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has designated helium as a critical material under the Energy Act of 2020 to strengthen American manufacturing and supply chain security.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Department of Energy said on Friday that Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has designated helium as a critical material under the Energy Act of 2020 to strengthen American manufacturing and supply chain security. The designation advances the Trump administration's push to reduce US reliance on foreign critical minerals, bolster domestic manufacturing and secure key materials for economic and national security, it said in a statement. The department determined that helium meets the statutory definition of a critical material due to its essential role in American manufacturing and growing exposure to supply chain risks, the agency said. Helium's unique properties make it essential for semiconductor manufacturing, with no viable substitutes for many critical applications, while the US has substantial domestic helium-rich natural gas resources to help meet growing industrial demand, the department said. Despite the nation's abundant helium resources, limited refining capacity and lengthy permitting timelines continue to constrain US production, the agency added.

item.title: Canciller argentino dice First Quantum Minerals prevé solicitar inclusión a plan RIGI por inversiones de hasta 5.250 mln dlr
item.description: First Quantum Minerals (FM.TO) prevé solicitar su inclusión al régimen de incentivos fiscales para grandes inversiones de Argentina (RIGI) antes de fin de año, informó el viernes el ministro de Relaciones Exteriores, Pablo Quirno en su cuenta de X.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: First Quantum Minerals (FM.TO) prevé solicitar su inclusión al régimen de incentivos fiscales para grandes inversiones de Argentina (RIGI) antes de fin de año, informó el viernes el ministro de Relaciones Exteriores, Pablo Quirno en su cuenta de X. La inversión podría alcanzar los 5.250 millones de dólares, señaló. El yacimiento de cobre en la norteña provincia de Salta Taca Taca, de First Quantum Minerals es uno de los mayores yacimientos de cobre sin desarrollar del mundo, añadió Quirno.

item.title: Órgão regulador de Wall Street vai focar fiscalização sobre IA e tokens
item.description: A Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) anunciou nesta sexta-feira que o uso de inteligência artificial, ativos privados e títulos tokenizados estará entre as principais áreas de foco da fiscalização que a agência realizará sobre as empresas de Wall Street no atual ano fiscal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) anunciou nesta sexta-feira que o uso de inteligência artificial, ativos privados e títulos tokenizados estará entre as principais áreas de foco da fiscalização que a agência realizará sobre as empresas de Wall Street no atual ano fiscal. O anúncio ocorre no momento em que o governo dos Estados Unidos vem tomando medidas para ampliar o acesso a ativos privados para investidores de varejo e fundos de aposentadoria, o que pode oferecer retornos mais elevados, mas também expõe os norte-americanos comuns a maiores riscos. No mês passado, a SEC também divulgou uma isenção de cinco anos para permitir que empresas ofereçam ações baseadas em blockchain ou tokenizadas. A divisão de fiscalização da SEC inspeciona empresas reguladas pela agência, como consultorias de investimento, corretoras, bolsas de valores e outras, e pode encaminhar constatações de irregularidades. No ano passado, a agência reduziu o foco na fiscalização do setor de criptomoedas. Em comunicado, a agência afirmou que, no ano fiscal de 2027 do governo federal, que teve início em 1º de outubro, as áreas prioritárias para os auditores incluirão fundos e crédito privado. Críticos afirmam que investidores comuns podem não obter os retornos mais elevados esperados com esses ativos e também podem não compreender as taxas envolvidas, ou que os ativos costumam ser difíceis de avaliar e não podem ser resgatados imediatamente em dinheiro. A SEC também planeja se concentrar no uso de inteligência artificial e outras tecnologias “que possam afetar as operações de mercado, a conformidade, a prevenção de fraudes e a proteção dos investidores”, bem como nos riscos associados a mudanças na estrutura do mercado, incluindo a tokenização de títulos, segundo o comunicado. (Por Douglas Gillison)

item.title: 米ロウクライナ和平協議、11月前半にアブダビで開催へ＝ゼレンスキー大統領
item.description:
Andrea Shalal Olena Harmash
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal　Olena Harmash

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２３日、ウクライナ、ロシア、米国の和平交渉担当者が、１１月前半にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビで実務レベルの協議を開くことで合意したと明らかにした。その後に３カ国の首脳会談が行われることを期待していると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏はシンクタンクのハドソン研究所にビデオリンクを通じて「計画では１１月前半、もちろんできるだけ早期に会合を開く予定だ」と語った。その上で、今月開催が見込まれていた同様の会合が実現しなかったことに言及し、多くはロシア次第であるとの見解を示した。

その上で、実務協議の後に３カ国の首脳会談を開催することが極めて重要だと強調した。

ゼレンスキー氏は、ロシアのプーチン大統領と今週会談したトランプ大統領の娘婿クシュナー氏、ウィットコフ中東担当特使と２３日に協議を行ったと説明。和平合意にはウクライナに対する強力な安全保障の保証と、ウクライナ軍を維持するための１０年間の資金拠出が必要になるとの見方を示した。

item.title: BP, Louisiana agree to resolve Deepwater Horizon disputes
item.description: BP and the US state of Louisiana on Friday agreed to resolve two long-running disputes tied to the 2010 Deepwater Horizon oil spill, including a single early payment of about $350 million and the settlement of remaining coastal zone lawsuits involving the company.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: BP (BP.L) and the US state of Louisiana on Friday agreed to resolve two long-running disputes tied to the 2010 Deepwater Horizon oil spill, including a single early payment of about $350 million and the settlement of remaining coastal zone lawsuits involving the company.

item.title: France, UAE revive Rafale warplane development amid French budget woes
item.description: France and the United Arab Emirates have revived plans to jointly develop an upgraded Rafale fighter jet after talks stumbled earlier this year, officials said, giving Paris a fresh opportunity to advance its flagship defence programme.
item.dc:creator: Florence Loeve, John Irish
item.content:encoded: France and the United Arab Emirates have revived plans to jointly develop an upgraded Rafale fighter jet after talks stumbled earlier this year, officials said, giving Paris a fresh opportunity to advance its flagship defence programme. The project, for which France's 2027 draft budget earmarks €3 billion ($3.36 billion), has returned to the top of the agenda after plans for [USN:S8N3Z704G TEXT:"France and Germany"] to jointly develop a next-generation fighter aircraft collapsed earlier this year. France's President Emmanuel Macron travelled to the region this week and agreed with UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed al-Nahyan to deepen a strategic defence agreement between the two countries. UAE, FRANCE HAVE CLOSE STRATEGIC TIES The UAE is [USN:L8N2SN4VZ TEXT:"France's biggest customer"] of the Rafale warplane, which is built by Dassault Aviation (AM.PA) . Paris, which has military bases in the UAE, has been deemed especially reliable by Abu Dhabi during the current conflict in the Gulf after sending air defence systems to the country and shooting down drones from Iran with its warplanes. "This trip enabled us to strengthen the defence relationship with the United Arab Emirates, where an important agreement was signed ... to establish a common strategy for the Rafale's fifth generation," Macron told reporters on Wednesday. Two people familiar with the matter said the focus would now turn to the cost and technical details of the programme during talks that will take place between the industrial players. Prior to the project stalling, La Tribune newspaper reported in April that its costs had reached €5 billion, with the UAE expected to fund roughly two-thirds. BUDGET SQUEEZE MAKES EMIRATI DEAL VITAL While Macron has pledged to accelerate rearmament in response to a more volatile security environment, officials face growing scrutiny over how to fund costly long-term programmes at a time of large budget deficits and rising debt. The budget squeeze has added importance to the Rafale F5 programme — also called F5 standard — which aims to give the fighter a mid-life upgrade and is seen as a cornerstone of France's future air combat capabilities. The upgrade is expected to integrate new connectivity and advanced weapons, helping maintain the aircraft's relevance well into the 2040s and serving as a bridge to future European combat aviation projects. Securing external partners and financing for the programme eases pressure on France's defence budget while preserving critical industrial and technological capabilities. Under the terms of any deal, the UAE is likely to demand some technology transfers or for parts of the production to be moved to its own territory. Analysts say that in the past this has created tensions with supplier nations and their defence industries, which have been reluctant to share strategic know-how or to move production abroad. A senior French official said there was a firm commitment from Abu Dhabi to work with France now, and Dassault was working with Emirati defence conglomerate EDGE Group. Dassault declined to comment on the agreement. Olivier Andries, chief executive of Safran (SAF.PA) , which manufactures the Rafale's engines, said on Friday that the agreement was "very good news". In a call with reporters, he declined to say which technology or production transfers would be considered as part of the deal. EDGE and Safran already cooperate on several areas including defence electronics and smart weapons. ($1 = 0.8929 euros)

item.title: Devils acquire G Connor Hellebuyck from Jets for multiple players, picks
item.description: The New Jersey Devils acquired three-time Vezina Trophy-winning goaltender Connor Hellebuyck from the Winnipeg Jets on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New Jersey Devils acquired three-time Vezina Trophy-winning goaltender Connor Hellebuyck from the Winnipeg Jets on Friday. The trade comes on the same day as the conclusion of Hellebuyck's suspension for failing to report to training camp. The Jets will receive forwards Dawson Mercer and Nick Bjugstad (long-term injured reserve), goaltender Nico Daws, a seventh-round pick in the 2027 NHL Draft, a second-round selection in 2029 and prospect Alexander Command, whom the Devils selected with the 12th overall pick of the 2026 NHL Draft. Hellebuyck will head to Newark, N.J., and join the Devils, who began the season with the goaltending tandem of Daws and Jake Allen. Hellebuyck, 33, requested a trade from the Jets this summer, citing the best interests of his family. "Several months ago, I privately requested a trade," Hellebuyck said in his statement on Aug. 27. "I have tried to handle the situation quietly and respectfully while giving the organization time to explore its options. With training camp approaching, I felt it was important to publicly confirm my request. My position has not changed, and I believe moving on is the best path forward for me and my family." Hellebuyck is in the third season of a seven-year, $59.5 million contract. He has a full no-movement clause, giving him control over any potential destination. He captured his third Vezina Trophy and added the Hart Trophy (NHL MVP) in 2025. He posted a 47-12-3 record with a .925 save percentage and league-best figures in goals-against average (2.00) and shutouts (eight). Hellebuyck was the star of the U.S. Olympic team that won the gold medal at the 2026 Games in Milan Cortina. He made 41 saves as the U.S. beat Canada 2-1 in overtime in the final. Hellebuyck, who grew up in Michigan, had a down season by his standards in 2025-26, finishing 23-23-11 with a 2.86 goals-against average and a career-worst .895 save percentage. Winnipeg failed to make the playoffs, going 35-35-12. In 625 career NHL games, Hellebuyck has a 345-208-55 record with a 2.58 GAA and a .916 save percentage. --Field Level Media

item.title: La Russie et l'Ukraine acceptent un cessez-le-feu à Oleshky
item.description: La Russie et l'Ukraine ont accepté de respecter un cessez-le-feu dans la ville ukrainienne d'Oleshky, occupée par la Russie, afin de permettre l'évacuation des civils pris au piège des combats, a annoncé vendredi la Maison blanche.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Russie et l'Ukraine ont accepté de respecter un cessez-le-feu dans la ville ukrainienne d'Oleshky, occupée par la Russie, afin de permettre l'évacuation des civils pris au piège des combats, a annoncé vendredi la Maison blanche. Moscou et Kyiv ont confirmé avoir accepté la proposition de la Première dame Melania Trump. Selon l'agence Interfax, le ministère russe de la Défense a déclaré que le cessez-le-feu entrerait en vigueur le 27 octobre à 04h00, heure locale, dans cette ville du sud de l'Ukraine occupée par les forces russes depuis février 2022 et située sur la ligne de front. La ville est nichée sur la rive orientale du Dniepr en face de Kherson, reconquise par l'armée ukrainienne fin 2022. Ses habitants ont multiplié les appels à l'aide, disant souffrir d'une crise alimentaire qui ne cesse de s'aggraver faute de ravitaillement. "Les deux pays ont convenu de suspendre temporairement toutes les opérations militaires à Oleshky afin de permettre l'acheminement de l'aide humanitaire et d'organiser l'évacuation des civils via un couloir de sécurité", a dit la Maison blanche dans un communiqué. Le principal négociateur ukrainien, David Arakhamia, a confirmé sur Telegram qu'un cessez-le-feu serait bientôt mis en place à Oleshky. Le Kremlin a indiqué de son côté que la cessation des combats durerait "au moins plusieurs jours" et que tous les civils qui le souhaitent pourraient quitter la ville vers la destination de leur choix. Le président Vladimir Poutine s'était dit prêt à coopérer sur le sujet lors d'un récent entretien téléphonique avec le pape Léon XIV. Melania Trump, qui s'est activement mobilisée pour que les enfants ukrainiens enlevés par la Russie pendant la guerre soient rendus à leurs familles, a également milité pour un tel cessez-le-feu. "La situation à Oleshky est désastreuse. Oleshky est une ville de guerre en première ligne, au bord de la catastrophe. La population restante d'Oleshky est principalement composée de personnes âgées qui ont un besoin urgent de soins médicaux, de médicaments, de nourriture et d'eau potable", dit la Première dame dans le communiqué de la Maison blanche. Oleshky compterait encore entre 1.700 et 2.000 habitants, dont une cinquantaine d'enfants, sur une population de 24.000 personnes avant la guerre. La quasi totalité de la ville a été inondée après la destruction d'un important barrage sur le Dniepr en 2023.

item.title: Tyler Robinson requests 2029 trial for alleged murder of Charlie Kirk
item.description: A Utah judge is expected to set on Friday a trial date for Tyler Robinson, the former electrical apprentice accused of killing prominent right-wing activist Charlie Kirk, with the defendant requesting a 2029 date and Kirk's widow calling for a trial next year.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Hay
item.content:encoded: A Utah judge is expected to set on Friday a trial date for Tyler Robinson, the former electrical apprentice accused of killing prominent [USN:L2N3UX161 TEXT:"right-wing activist Charlie Kirk"], with the defendant requesting a 2029 date and Kirk's widow calling for a trial next year. Judge Tony Graf will open a hearing at 1 p.m. (1900 GMT) to decide a date to start the high-profile, capital trial of Robinson, who allegedly shot Kirk as he debated with students at a Utah university in September 2025. Utah prosecutors are seeking the death penalty for Robinson and requested a January 31, 2028, start date for a trial they expect to last 17 weeks, according to their scheduling memo. Robinson, 23, has pleaded not guilty to seven counts, including aggravated murder, for allegedly shooting Kirk as he held one of his trademark debates at Utah Valley University in Orem. In a legal filing, Robinson's lawyers said they expected a six-to-seven-month trial and requested it start in the third quarter of 2029. They said Robinson's case required years of preparation due to voluminous evidence and issues such as the venue, jury selection and witnesses. Kirk's widow Erika said the defense request was "grossly out of line with comparable cases" and asked that the trial start as early as possible next year, preferably no later than October 4, according to a legal filing. Charlie Kirk was a polarizing figure in US politics. He was an ally of President Donald Trump who was admired by conservatives for mobilizing young voters around his Christian and right-wing views. Kirk was criticized by opponents for his rhetoric on immigration, race, gender and other social issues. Prosecutors [USN:L6N43V09L TEXT:"allege"] Robinson targeted Kirk for his opposition to gay marriage and transgender rights. Defense attorney Richard Novak said Kirk spoke "hatefully" about people who did not have traditional gender identities or were not heterosexual, but there was no evidence Robinson opposed those views.

item.title: Iran has detailed plans to hit Gulf undersea cables if war resumes, officials say
item.description: Tehran has drawn up detailed plans to target undersea communications cables in the Gulf if the United States and Israel attack Iran again, two senior Iranian security officials told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tehran has drawn up detailed plans to target [USN:L6N41B0XO TEXT:"undersea communications cables"] in the Gulf if the United States and Israel attack Iran again, two senior Iranian security officials told Reuters. Their comments followed warnings by Iranian officials that undersea cables in the region could become targets in any renewed conflict if diplomacy with Washington collapses. The two Iranian security officials, speaking on condition of anonymity, gave few details and did not say how or where exactly Tehran would carry out such attacks. But one of them said Iran would aim to prevent repairs after any attacks to prolong disruptions to communications, including internet connections. "If Iran is attacked, there will be no more red lines ... from undersea cables to military bases, including covert ones," one of the officials said. The official warned Washington not to "play with fire", and said Iran had full access to the undersea cables and could easily destroy them. Yadollah Javani, the deputy head of political affairs for Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC), said on Wednesday that Iran could target seven major internet cables beneath the Strait of Hormuz if Iranian infrastructure came under attack. Undersea cables carry around 99% of global internet traffic, according to the International Telecommunication Union, a UN agency. But the global impact of such attacks by Iran could be limited as less than 1% of international bandwidth passes through the Strait of Hormuz, said Alan Mauldin, research director at telecommunications research firm TeleGeography. The strait separates Iran and Oman, linking the Gulf to the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea. The US Department of State and Iran's Foreign Ministry did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment on the Iranian security officials' remarks. There was no immediate comment from Gulf states. 'STRONGER RESPONSE' The plans for possible attacks on undersea cables reflect a conviction in Iran's leadership that a renewed US military campaign would have to be met with [USN:L8N45M1N4 TEXT:"a stronger response"] than before. Top security official Mohsen Rezaei warned this month that US-linked digital infrastructure across the Gulf, including data centres and AI facilities, could be targeted in a renewed conflict. Washington's Gulf allies have invested heavily in such infrastructure and they "should hold Washington, not Tehran, responsible for any damage to undersea cables," the second Iranian security official said. Alex Vatanka, director of the Iran program at the Middle East Institute in Washington, said such threats were intended to deter renewed conflict and put pressure on Washington by making Gulf governments and US companies fear for their investments in the region. "Tehran wants Gulf states and corporate executives to press (US President Donald) Trump over the risks his policies pose to their investment plans," said Vatanka. Multiple cable cuts could slow internet services and disrupt financial transactions, e-commerce and cloud computing, analysts said. The impact would depend on how operators rerouted traffic and the capacity available on alternative connections, Mauldin said. Restoring connections during wartime could be difficult, experts said, and higher insurance costs and delays in obtaining permits to enter territorial waters could further complicate repairs. The Red Sea could offer a more significant target than the Strait of Hormuz, particularly if Iran had support from its Houthi allies in Yemen, though Tehran has made no public statement indicating it plans to target cables there. The Red Sea carries data between Europe, East Africa and Asia, with capacity routed through it accounting for about 3% of global international demand and around 10% of traffic travelling between regions, Mauldin said. Gulf governments have been investing heavily in technology to diversify beyond oil and become global artificial intelligence hubs, deepening ties with US technology firms. Iranian strikes directly hit two Amazon Web Services facilities in the UAE in March and damaged infrastructure near one of its facilities in Bahrain. The IRGC named US tech companies including Microsoft, Google, Apple and Nvidia as legitimate targets at the height of the war in March. Land-based connections can provide alternative routes for internet traffic, and Gulf states and US technology companies are investing in additional infrastructure to improve resilience. [USN:S8N43F050 TEXT:"Microsoft plans to invest"] more than $400 million in subsea and terrestrial connectivity across the Middle East by 2030.

item.title: EEUU autoriza liberación de emergencia de hasta 400.000 barriles de crudo de la reserva estratégica
item.description: El Departamento de Energía de Estados Unidos anunció el viernes que autorizó un intercambio de emergencia de hasta 400.000 barriles de crudo procedentes de la Reserva Estratégica de Petróleo (SPR) para hacer frente a una interrupción del suministro que afecta a la refinería de Phillips 66 en Lake Charles, Luisiana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Departamento de Energía de Estados Unidos anunció el viernes que autorizó un intercambio de emergencia de hasta 400.000 barriles de crudo procedentes de la Reserva Estratégica de Petróleo (SPR) para hacer frente a una interrupción del suministro que afecta a la refinería de Phillips 66 en Lake Charles, Luisiana. La SPR ya se encuentra en su nivel más bajo desde 1982, después de que el presidente Donald Trump recurriera a ella cuando la guerra contra Irán interrumpió las líneas de suministro. Su predecesor en el cargo, Joe Biden, también recurrió a ella después de la invasión a gran escala de Ucrania por parte de Rusia. La refinería de Lake Charles tiene una capacidad para refinar unos 264.000 barriles por día. Este suministro "ayudará a compensar las interrupciones temporales que afectan a las entregas de crudo a la refinería y respaldará la producción continuada de combustibles para el transporte destinados a Luisiana y los mercados circundantes", señaló el departamento. La refinería recibirá crudo de la SPR, según confirmó el viernes un portavoz de Phillips 66, aunque se negó a hacer comentarios sobre las operaciones de la refinería o la actividad comercial. "No prevemos que esto afecte a las operaciones de Lake Charles", afirmó.

item.title: Proyecto de chilena Codelco con Pucobre recibe permiso ambiental: Diario Financiero
item.description: El proyecto Tovaku, que asocia a la gigante estatal chilena Codelco con la privada Pucobre, recibió el viernes el permiso ambiental para su desarrollo, informó el local Diario Financiero.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El proyecto Tovaku, que asocia a la gigante estatal chilena Codelco con la privada Pucobre, recibió el viernes el permiso ambiental para su desarrollo, informó el local Diario Financiero. En agosto, las empresas anunciaron la alianza que tiene prevista una inversión de 870 millones de dólares, que busca producir 46.000 toneladas anuales de cátodos de cobre y una vida útil proyectada de 21 años. El diario detalló que por unanimidad la Comisión de Evaluación Ambiental (Coeva) de la norteña región de Antofagasta dio luz verde a la iniciativa en la que Pucobre posee un 60% y Codelco el restante 40%. Para el proyecto, Codelco aportará las concesiones mineras, que cuenta con reservas por 633 millones de toneladas, mientras que Pucobre contribuirá con los estudios ya realizados, y estará a cargo del financiamiento de las etapas de desarrollo y construcción.

item.title: Tech stocks sound an uncomfortable 2008 echo
item.description: The industry is now 40% of the S&P 500. A sharp sell-off on AI fears is a reminder that such lop-sidedness marked prior booms and busts. Unlike the dotcom era, frenzied activity is lifting earnings faster than valuations. The financial crisis shows that this can be a bigger risk.
item.dc:creator: Robert Cyran
item.content:encoded: The S&P 500 Index (.SPX) represents over three-quarters of the world’s biggest equity market by value, making it the ultimate barometer of investors’ obsessions. Right now, that means technology: the industry accounts for nearly 40% of its total capitalization, according to LSEG data. A sharp sell-off as fears rise over the pace of the artificial intelligence boom is a reminder that such lop-sidedness has preceded prior busts. What started as a slump for money-losing, upstart data-center operators like CoreWeave (CRWV.O) has since widened. The so-called neocloud’s stock, down 17% just since Monday, is now joined by colossus Meta Platforms (META.O) , tumbling 7% on Thursday after indicating it could issue billions in equity to fund boss Mark Zuckerberg’s AI ambitions. Even companies that should benefit from ever-more spending - chipmakers like AMD (AMD.O) and Micron (MU.O) or power producers like Constellation Energy (CEG.O) fell too. It’s a sign that the mania undergirding repeated records for the S&P 500 is being reassessed. If the sell-off deepens, it might be tempting to draw comparisons to the dotcom blow-up in 2000. Technology companies’ share of the blue-chip index had tripled over the preceding two years to comprise a third of its market capitalization. Investors put greater and greater value on hallucinatory projected future earnings. When the fever broke, tech’s share receded to its prior level. Yet today’s valuations don’t look inflated: investors pay about the same for expected earnings over the next 12 months as they did before ChatGPT's release in 2022. Chips, software and cloud computing are only becoming more important, so a multi-decade rise in the value of companies making them seems natural. The 50% leap in the sector’s share of the S&P 500 since the AI wave kicked off, though, looks suspiciously large. Something similarly led up to the 2008 banking crisis. The financial sector’s share of the index had similarly bloomed, nearly doubling between 2000 and 2007. But increased earnings provided the spur, while multiples barely moved. Investors were skeptical that earnings could keep rising, but not enough. A housing-led Wall Street boom turned out to be built on sand, and collapsed. Then as now, the risk is that vast sums of capital are being misallocated. Earnings overall are rising thanks to a wave of data center construction, but if hoped-for demand doesn't emerge, returns would disappoint, revenue for chipmakers could disappear and circular deals between suppliers and customers could turn vicious. Working off excess capacity would take a long time: at $10 trillion, a Brookings Institution researcher recently pegged AI as the largest infrastructure boom ever. Given tech’s inflated importance, it makes sense for even amorphous fears to produce large tremors. Follow Robert Cyran on Bluesky . The technology-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index fell 2.6% on October 22, its biggest one-day fall since June. Tech giant Meta Platforms fell 7%, while chipmaker AMD declined 8% and peer Micron fell 6%. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: PwC confirma incidente de segurança digital envolvendo dados de funcionários
item.description: A PwC anunciou nesta sexta-feira que está ciente de um incidente de segurança eletrônica envolvendo um fornecedor terceirizado utilizado para hospedar registros de treinamento dos funcionários da empresa, um dia após um grupo de hackers ter alegado que roubou 590 gigabytes de dados da empresa.
item.dc:creator: A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: A PwC anunciou nesta sexta-feira que está ciente de um incidente de segurança eletrônica envolvendo um fornecedor terceirizado utilizado para hospedar registros de treinamento dos funcionários da empresa, um dia após um grupo de hackers ter alegado que roubou 590 gigabytes de dados da empresa. Um porta-voz global da PwC afirmou que “o local afetado não armazena dados de clientes, dados pessoais confidenciais nem informações financeiras. Assim que tomamos conhecimento desse incidente, agimos prontamente para proteger o ambiente e realizar uma análise minuciosa”. O incidente “não afeta nossa rede nem nenhuma de nossas operações”, disse o porta-voz. Um grupo de extorsão digital chamado “Everest” assumiu a responsabilidade pela violação dos dados em uma mensagem publicada em seu site em 22 de outubro, de acordo com a plataforma de pesquisa sobre crimes digitais eCrime.ch. A mensagem incluiu um cronômetro com cinco dias restantes e uma advertência indicando que os dados serão divulgados caso a empresa não faça um acordo com o grupo. O Everest alegou ter roubado 590 gigabytes de dados, incluindo “componentes de software e cursos de e-learning da PwC”. Os dados contêm informações “sobre indivíduos e seu histórico organizacional e profissional”, afirmou o Everest, incluindo nomes, endereços de email, números de telefone, endereços e outros detalhes. O porta-voz da PwC se recusou a comentar sobre a quantidade de dados roubados ou a veracidade das alegações do grupo de hackers.

item.title: Ilhan Omar quote on enslaving white men is fabricated
item.description: A quote attributed to US Representative Ilhan Omar about putting white men “in chains as slaves” is fabricated. There is no record of Omar making the remark and her office told Reuters she made no such statement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: A quote attributed to US Representative Ilhan Omar about putting white men “in chains as slaves” is fabricated. There is no record of Omar making the remark and her office told Reuters she made no such statement. · Posts feature a graphic quoting Omar: "I am America's hope and the president's nightmare. I think all white men should be put in chains as slaves because they will never submit to Islam." Text on the image calls these "her own Twitter words." · However, only the first sentence is accurate. Omar called herself "America's hope and the president's nightmare" in reference to Trump during an appearance on The Daily Show with Trevor Noah. The episode was posted to YouTube in November 2018 but was originally broadcast on July 13, 2017. · She did not make the remarks about white men during the show and a search of her public and official social media accounts shows no record of such a statement. · The photograph used in the graphic was taken for the September 2017 issue of TIME magazine , which featured Omar in its “Firsts” project about women leaders, but the quote does not appear anywhere in the published article. · Omar’s press team told Reuters by email, “She never said that.” Omar also addressed the screenshots on X when they appeared in 2018, responding: “Who said facts mattered?” · Verdict: False. Omar did not say white men “should be put in chains as slaves because they will never submit to Islam." This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

item.title: US fines Air France, KLM over flights in prohibited Iraqi airspace
item.description: The US Transportation Department said Friday it was fining Air France and KLM a total of $425,000 for operating dozens of flights in Iraqi airspace below a minimum altitude intended to protect them from threats from the ground.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The US Transportation Department said Friday it was fining Air France and KLM (AIRF.PA) a total of $425,000 for operating dozens of flights in Iraqi airspace below a minimum altitude intended to protect them from threats from the ground. The Federal Aviation Administration prohibits flight operations by US operators in foreign-managed airspace where conflict, militant activity, or heightened tensions can threaten the safety of flights. Foreign airlines operating flights with a US airline’s code must abide by these prohibitions, and KLM and Air France both operate flights with Delta codes. An FAA order in place for more than six years bars flights over Iraq at altitudes below 32,000 feet. Air France operated more than 30 flights and KLM more than 100 flights carrying the Delta code through FAA-prohibited airspace over Iraq between early 2022 and 2025, USDOT said. USDOT said the airlines must pay $265,000 of the $425,000 within 60 days and the remainder of the fines will be payable if there are any other violations within one year. The airlines did not immediately comment but Air France and KLM told USDOT they were fully committed to adhering to regulatory requirements at all times and took the issue extremely seriously. Both airlines said that due to conflicting traffic, local air traffic controllers had directly instructed their flight crews to descend or refused to allow them to ascend. Both said they believe the flights should have fallen under the “emergency situations” exemption given the safety implications of refusing an air traffic control order. Delta declined to comment.

item.title: US telecom operators wobble after report SpaceX in talks for cell sites
item.description: US telecom stocks declined on Friday after a report that SpaceX was seeking thousands of cell sites for a fourth wireless carrier, fueling concerns over fresh competition.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US telecom stocks declined on Friday after a report that SpaceX was seeking thousands of cell sites for a fourth wireless carrier, fueling concerns over fresh competition. Elon Musk's rocket and space technology company was in talks to access at least 80,000 cell sites to build its wireless carrier from scratch, Bloomberg News reported late on Thursday, citing sources familiar with the matter. AT&T (T.N) fell 5.6% to a more than three-month low, Verizon (VZ.N) lost 1.6% and T-Mobile shed 5%. Germany's Deutsche Telekom (DTEGn.DE) , which holds an over 50% stake in T-Mobile, lost 3.2%. "The competitive impact may still be years away, but anticipation alone, reinforced by each successive spectrum and infrastructure move, is likely to remain an overhang on sector sentiment," Bernstein analysts said in a note. Tower operators and SpaceX did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The report comes weeks after SpaceX [USN:L4N45U1O2 TEXT:"acquired low-band spectrum"] to advance its carrier plans, mounting a direct, orbital challenge to legacy wireless giants in the US and sending AT&T and Verizon shares to their worst one-day falls in more than two decades. Bernstein analysts said that an MVNO (mobile virtual network operator) deal with SpaceX may not appeal to telecom operators, but a unified stance against one has done little to lift sentiment, leaving carriers to reassess their options. SpaceX's Starlink has been generating revenue from internet services in sparsely populated and rural areas, but becoming a true rival to major carriers will [USN:L4N45V0SC TEXT:"require years of work"] and a terrestrial network. Tower operator Crown Castle (CCI.N) , however, surged 11.6% after the report identified it as one of the cellular infrastructure companies SpaceX was in talks with. Other operators also rose, with American Tower (AMT.N) up 4.9% and SBA Communications adding 4.6%. Shares of SpaceX rose 1.7%.

item.title: Brewers add Brandon Woodruff to World Series roster
item.description: MILWAUKEE -- The Milwaukee Brewers added right-hander Brandon Woodruff to the World Series roster on Friday following his unexpected comeback from a shoulder injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MILWAUKEE -- The Milwaukee Brewers added right-hander Brandon Woodruff to the World Series roster on Friday following his unexpected comeback from a shoulder injury. The Brewers replaced right-hander Chad Patrick, the only change to the 26-man roster (13 pitchers, 13 position players) for the best-of-seven series against the Tampa Bay Rays. Game 1 is Friday night in Milwaukee. Woodruff, a two-time All-Star who has been with the Brewers since they drafted him in the 11th round in 2014, has not pitched since July 4. The team's longest-tenured active player was originally scheduled for surgery, which was canceled after he showed signs of improvement. Woodruff, 33, began a throwing program in late August and threw off a mound during each of the Brewers' first two postseason series. He threw about two dozen live pitches Tuesday to teammates. "It went as good as it could have gone," Woodruff said Thursday. "And I've probably made their decision a little bit harder, which is a good problem for them. So, I'm lucky, I'm blessed. We got a chance to win the World Series and regardless of what happens, I will be just as excited to win if I'm on the roster or not." Woodruff, who missed most of the 2025 season recovering from shoulder surgery, was 2-2 with a 2.98 ERA in nine starts during the 2026 regular season. For his career, Woodruff is 1-3 with a 3.18 ERA, 40 strikeouts and just four walks in 28 1/3 innings across eight postseason games (four starts). "This is a guy that's one of the most successful, dominant big-game pitchers I've ever been around," president of baseball operations Matt Arnold said on Thursday. Woodruff is 55-30 with a 3.10 ERA since debuting with the Brewers in 2017. At the end of last season, he took a $10 million buyout after declining his half of a mutual option, but then accepted a $22.025 million, one-year qualifying offer. His unexpected postseason return comes as Milwaukee plays in its first World Series since 1982. "I just wanted to be an option at this point," Woodruff said. "I know what I bring to the table as a player and I'll always believe in myself." --Field Level Media

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe finit dans le rouge, la France attend le verdict de Moody's
item.description: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en baisse vendredi, dans un climat peu favorable aux actions, les cours du pétrole grimpant à nouveau et les finances publiques françaises suscitant de plus en plus de méfiance alors que Moody's doit actualiser la note de crédit de la deuxième économie de la zone euro.
item.dc:creator: Diana Mandia
item.content:encoded: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en baisse vendredi, dans un climat peu favorable aux actions, les cours du pétrole grimpant à nouveau et les finances publiques françaises suscitant de plus en plus de méfiance alors que Moody's doit actualiser la note de crédit de la deuxième économie de la zone euro. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) a perdu 0,36% à 7.782,82 points. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) a reculé 0,86% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a abandonné 0,32%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) a fini sur un recul de 0,44%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,30% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,42%. Sur la semaine, l'indice vedette de la Bourse de Paris cède 2,19%, tandis que l'indice paneuropéen perd 1,50%. La semaine qui s'achève aura été de haute tension pour les marchés obligataires français, avec le rendement de l'OAT à 10 ans franchissant la barre symbolique des 5%, une première depuis l'été 2002, ce qui illustre l'inquiétude croissante des investisseurs face à un pays qui peine à réduire ses déficits. Si la dette souveraine française s'est légèrement redressée vendredi, abandonnant 7,4 points de base (pdb) pour s'établir à 5,0160% en fin de séance, son gain hebdomadaire est le plus fort parmi les principaux pays de la zone euro, et de nouveaux défis se profilent déjà à court terme. L'agence de notation Moody's actualisera dans la soirée la note de crédit de la France, et le risque d'une dégradation est palpable, d'autant plus que d'autres agences de premier plan l'ont déjà fait. Avec un dispositif sécuritaire renforcé, le pays [USN:L8N4691MR TEXT:"se prépare"] par ailleurs à une nouvelle journée de manifestations à haut risque samedi, une semaine après les violences et les pillages survenus en marge de défilés pour les conditions d'enseignement détériorées et contre la vie chère. La polarisation politique observée au cours de ces derniers mois du mandat d'Emmanuel Macron à l'Élysée inquiète les investisseurs, qui redoutent le scénario anticipé par les sondages, selon lesquels les options politiques les plus extrêmes se retrouveraient au second tour de l'élection présidentielle de 2027, ce qui ajoute à la nervosité face à une trajectoire budgétaire déjà incertaine. L'attention des investisseurs se portera également la semaine prochaine sur la réunion de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) qui, selon toutes les prévisions, devrait maintenir ses taux inchangés après deux relèvements en juin et en septembre. Les investisseurs seront impatients d'entendre ce que la présidente Christine Lagarde aura à dire sur les perspectives économiques, mais aussi de savoir si les tensions autour des obligations françaises pourraient déstabiliser le marché. Et tout cela alors que les craintes inflationnistes ne s'apaisent pas : le prix Brent évolue vendredi son plus haut niveau depuis début mai, à plus de 117 dollars le baril, les attaques des Houthis en Arabie saoudite faisant resurgir la menace de nouvelles perturbations des approvisionnements en provenance du Moyen-Orient. VALEURS L'action Kering (PRTP.PA) a plongé de plus de 16% vendredi, au lendemain des résultats trimestriels du géant français du luxe, marqués par une baisse des ventes de Gucci, sa marque phare, dans un contexte de faiblesse persistante de la fréquentation de ses magasins. Les chiffres de l'Oréal (OREP.PA) (+5,6%) ont en revanche été salués, la croissance des ventes trimestrielles étant supérieure aux attentes. À Paris également, Safran (SAF.PA) a perdu 10%, les investisseurs craignant que le ralentissement de la croissance des ventes sur le marché des pièces de rechange ne se prolonge jusqu'en 2027. Le groupe de restauration collective Sodexo (EXHO.PA) a quant à lui grimpé de 6,2% après avoir publié un chiffre d'affaires annuel plus important que prévu. Ailleurs en Europe, Volvo Cars (VOLCARb.ST) a dégringolé de 24%, le groupe suédois ayant publié une perte d'exploitation au troisième trimestre et annoncé la suppression de 2.500 emplois pour réduire ses coûts face à la concurrence chinoise. A WALL STREET La prudence l'emporte à New York après une forte vague de ventes sur les titres liés à l'IA la veille. A l'heure de la clôture en Europe, le Dow Jones (.DJI) perd 1,02% et le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) 0,21%, tandis que le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gagne 0,16% après sa nette baisse de jeudi. Les actions du secteur des télécommunications sont particulièrement malmenées après que l'agence Bloomberg a rapporté que SpaceX (SPCX.O) était en pourparlers avec des entreprises d'infrastructures de téléphonie mobile en vue du lancement d'un opérateur national. L'indice S&P 500 des services de communication (.SPLRCL) perd 0,54%, et les opérateurs AT&T (T.N) , Verizon (VZ.N) et T-Mobile (TMUS.O) évoluent tous dans le rouge. LES INDICATEURS DU JOUR Dans la zone euro, les indices PMI préliminaires d'octobre ont brossé un tableau pour le moins peu encourageant quant à l'impact des pressions inflationnistes et budgétaires sur l'activité du secteur privé, dont [USN:ZRN00EPDP TEXT:"la croissance"] a ralenti pour atteindre son rythme le plus bas depuis juin. [USN:ZRN00EPD5 TEXT:"En France"], l'activité s'est contractée de façon inattendue, tandis [USN:ZRN00EPDA TEXT:"qu'en Allemagne"] elle a décéléré, les entrées de nouvelles commandes n'ayant que modestement augmenté. Aux Etats-Unis, la [USN:L8N4691LX TEXT:"confiance des consommateurs"] a légèrement reculé ce mois-ci pour s'établir près de son plus bas historique de mai, affectée par la hausse des prix liée au conflit au Moyen-Orient, montrent les résultats définitifs de l'enquête mensuelle de l'Université du Michigan. "Le pouvoir d'achat continue de dominer la perception qu'ont les consommateurs de l'économie (...) Le moral des consommateurs est désormais inférieur de 10% à ce qu'il était il y a un an et de 15% par rapport à février, juste avant le conflit avec l'Iran", a déclaré Joanne Hsu, directrice des enquêtes auprès des consommateurs. CHANGES Le dollar gagne 0,16% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l''euro perd 0,15% à 1,1197 dollar , la devise européenne s'apprêtant à enregistrer une baisse hebdomadaire face au billet vert. Les tensions sur le marché obligataire, avec la prime de risque de la dette française évoluant à son plus haut niveau depuis la crise de la dette souveraine en 2011, en sont en grande partie responsables. TAUX Le rendement des bons du Trésor américain à 10 ans progresse vendredi, même s'il reste inférieur à 5% après la forte baisse enregistrée la veille, les inquiétudes liées à l'IA incitant les investisseurs à se tourner vers les valeurs refuges. Le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans affiche ainsi 4,2 points de base à 4,9945%. Le deux ans gagne à son tour 5,7 points de base à 4,6924%. Dans la zone euro, Le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans a fini quasi stable à 3,3426% En Italie, où la dette souveraine fait également l'objet d'une attention accrue, le rendement des obligations d'État à dix ans a baissé de 3,4 points de base, s'établissant à 4,5784%. L'Italie pourrait par ailleurs alourdir la fiscalité des entreprises du secteur de l'énergie afin de financer des baisses d'impôts et des hausses de dépenses dans le budget pour la période 2027-2029, qui sera présenté la semaine prochaine, ont indiqué à Reuters des sources proches du dossier. Le marché obligataire retiendra également l'attention des investisseurs la semaine prochaine au Royaume-Uni, où le ministre des Finances, John Healey, présentera ce mercredi son premier budget. PÉTROLE Le Brent gagne 3,51% à 117,14 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) 3,53% à 102,98 dollars. A SUIVRE LE 26 OCTOBRE : [USN:L8N4621GO] (Certaines données peuvent accuser un léger décalage)

item.title: Trump sopesa entre un fin rápido a la guerra con Irán y dejar que el conflicto "se apague"
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el viernes que su país podría poner un fin rápido a la guerra con Irán, pero se preguntó si Washington debería buscar una conclusión acelerada del conflicto o permitir que se vaya apagando poco a poco.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el viernes que su país podría poner un fin rápido a la guerra con Irán, pero se preguntó si Washington debería buscar una conclusión acelerada del conflicto o permitir que se vaya apagando poco a poco. "Podríamos ponerle fin con mucha rapidez", señaló. "¿Queremos acabar con ella o simplemente dejar que se apague por sí sola?". En declaraciones a los medios en el Jardín Sur de la Casa Blanca, al partir hacia Florida, Trump señaló que el petróleo está saliendo a través del estrecho de Ormuz. "Estamos consiguiendo todo lo que queremos", indicó.

item.title: First Quantum readies Argentina tax-break plans for $5.3 billion Taca Taca copper project
item.description: First Quantum Minerals plans to apply before year-end for Argentina's large-investment incentive regime for its Taca Taca copper project, Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno said on Friday, in an investment of up to $5.25 billion for one of the world's largest undeveloped copper projects.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: First Quantum Minerals plans to apply before year-end for Argentina's large-investment incentive regime for its Taca Taca copper project, Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno said on Friday, in an investment of [USN:S0N3YE06I TEXT:"up to $5.25 billion"] for one of the world's largest undeveloped copper projects. Argentina's RIGI tax-break mechanism is part of President Javier Milei's drive to [USN:L1N3HP30W TEXT:"attract foreign capital"] to Argentina, including in its mining sector, and the push to turn the country into a bigger supplier of copper - a metal vital for power grids, electric vehicles and data centers. Quirno said the project involved an initial investment of $4.2 billion that could rise to $5.25 billion, creating as many as 4,000 construction jobs and 2,000 operating jobs. Located in the northwestern province of Salta, Taca Taca is a large, long-life copper project that First Quantum has said could produce about 209,000 metric tons of copper annually over a 35-year mine life, with scope for future expansion. Taca Taca would give First Quantum a potential new long-life source of production at a time when miners are [USN:L8N3Y6156 TEXT:"racing to secure"] future copper supply, and as First Quantum works to rebuild growth after the shutdown of its [USN:L1N45L16L TEXT:"flagship Cobre Panama"] mine.

item.title: KLM cancela decenas de vuelos debido a los fuertes vientos: portavoz
item.description: La aerolínea KLM, la filial neerlandesa de Air France KLM , canceló el viernes 20 vuelos debido a los fuertes vientos que azotaron Países Bajos a causa de la tormenta Austen, y se prevén otras 22 cancelaciones para el sábado, según informó un portavoz.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La aerolínea KLM, la filial neerlandesa de Air France KLM (AIRF.PA) , canceló el viernes 20 vuelos debido a los fuertes vientos que azotaron Países Bajos a causa de la tormenta Austen, y se prevén otras 22 cancelaciones para el sábado, según informó un portavoz. El servicio meteorológico neerlandés (KNMI) advirtió que se esperan fuertes rachas de viento de entre 75 y 90 kilómetros por hora en varias zonas del país el viernes y durante todo el fin de semana.
